payload.posture: Read Micah 3:8–12 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states leaders’ violence and false confidence lead to a sentence of plowed Zion and a wooded temple height. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
